args.message:
Implement banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

The nightly build failed because src/money.py used ROUND_HALF_UP despite
the docstring and FIN-212 requiring banker's rounding. Switch to
ROUND_HALF_EVEN so tests/test_money.py passes.

args.body:
## Summary
The nightly build failed because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was incorrectly using `ROUND_HALF_UP` despite its docstring claiming otherwise.

## Changes
- `src/money.py`: switch `round_money` to quantize with `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` (was `ROUND_HALF_UP`), matching the documented FIN-212 behavior.

## Verification
- CI run `ci-0001` on `08d3cd5986` passed, including `tests/test_money.py` (e.g. `2.675 → 2.68`, `2.665 → 2.66`).

Closes the nightly build failure related to FIN-212.
args.head: fix/fin-212-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212
